notes.title: Aarik joins the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase!
notes.content:
The Cerebral Puzzle Showcase is a Steam event coupled with a Steam sale. 

Shatterproof Games is very happy to be able to include Aarik And The Ruined Kingdom in the showcase at a discount. 

The event will last from the 29th of May to the 5th of June and during that time Aarik's adventure will be available for 72% off. 

Happy Puzzling!

notes.title: Bug Patch 0.02.02
notes.content:
Hot-fix for resolution settings issues raised in community hub:
- Removed repeating "click" sound when highlighting menu buttons.
- Resolution settings dropdown re-instated for mouse/kb users in settings menu.
- Dropdown/Scroll selection will swap out based on last input used so players with gamepads active (but using the mouse to play) will experience the dropdown selection method.
- Gamepad users (inc. Steamdeck) will retain the use of the scroll selection (as it is easier to use with a gp).
- Windowed option will remain persistent on resolution changes.
- Further optimisation to all levels. 
- Main shader optimisations. 
- UI canvas redraw optimisations.
- Fade animation will update with resolution changes (avoiding fade animation bug).
- Settings tab and dropdown selection states made more obvious.

notes.title: Aarik's Mega Update 1
notes.content:
Aarik's adventure has had some large updates that we would like to share with you, some are very visible, some are working behind the scenes to improve player experiences.

- We have implemented a huge UI overhaul to make the UI more stylish and hopefully more readable. 
- Achievement notifications have been added so that players can see when they have completed a new achievement at a glance from the main menu.
- Click sensitivity has been improved. Smaller objects will be easier to grab and tiles easier to click on.
- Gamepad movement improvements have been included.
- You can now change direction on the fly whilst moving Aarik (or his mother).
- New UI elements have been added to the settings menu to make resolution and localisation settings more accessible to controllers.
- Fixes have been made to bugs with the cursor at lower resolutions when using a controller.
- Improvements to the look and feel of Aarik's movement have been made.

Thankyou for your attention, we hope you enjoy the updates!

notes.title: Quality Of Life Update 1
notes.content:
Patch notes for QOL Update 1

Saving: 
- You can now create up to 3 saves.
- Saves can be accessed via the main menu, created, deleted and selected. 
- You can now view an overview of your progress via the save menu/ saves.
- Every save can contribute to Steam achievements. 

Bugs:
- Goal cameras now sync properly preventing jarring movements on level completion. 
- Teleporter juddering is gone.
- You can no longer walk through the goal after the level is complete. 
- Mining bots can now continue walking on platforms as you move them and won't jump about.
- Camera juddering when animating fixed. 
- Swamp water foam fixed. 
- Water foam juddering fixed on lower spec devices.
- Waterfalls in Viaducts final puzzle set to rescind properly when turning Viaducts.
- Lord Blockhead bubbles turn off upon saving them.
- Language drop-down errors fixed.

Graphical improvements: 
- Waterfall material looks improved.
- Water shader accuracy improved. 
- Camera framing of some levels improved.
- Improvements to animation/camera syncing. Animation smoothness.
- General improvements to all camera animations.

Optimisations: 
- Drastic improvement to load times. 
- Improvements to memory usage in general.
- Save speed improved significantly. 
- Audio latency improved. 

Localisation:
- Turkish translation added. 
- Spanish translation improved. 
- Portuguese (Brazil) translation improved.

notes.title: Demo Mouse Control Fixes
notes.content:
Thank you all for the brilliant feedback that we have been receiving!
We have heard you loud and clear and to this end we are pushing an update to the mouse controls.

From the latest build onwards mouse controls will shift to a "click to move towards" system. Click on the tile that you want to move to and Aarik will work his way towards it.

Hopefully this will remove any frustration with changes in direction etc, if not we will take that on board and have a re-think.

This adjustment has also allowed us to remove the "click and hold" aspect of the draggable objects so they should also be more responsive. 

We look forward to actioning even more suggestions in the future.

Summary:
- Mouse controls updated.
- Click and drag improved.

notes.title: Aarik's First Steps
notes.content:
We are very excited to announce that the Demo for Aarik And The Ruined Kingdom is now live. 
Head out into the Ruined Kingdom and explore the first few levels!

[b]What’s in the demo?[/b]

[list]
[*] Kick-start the adventure and play through the first 7 levels.
[*] Collect Steam Achievements as you go (Achievements will be awarded in the full game).
[*] Try out the first two “Crown Power” puzzle types along with other gameplay elements.  
[/list]    

[b]Feedback: [/b]

You can leave feedback for the demo in the main menu, in-game menu and at the end of the game. Alternatively you can post your thoughts here in response to this announcement.

We would love to hear what you think about our demo. Every bit of feedback that we get goes into making our game the best that it can be. We have already enacted some quality of life updates and are poised to fix even more!

[b]Localisation:[/b]

French, Spanish, German and Italian translations are available from the game settings. These are google translate powered and as such may be inaccurate.  
If you spot any mistakes or would like your language to be added please get in touch.
